name: popsicle
headline: UGCVidGen: Generate UGC Videos at Scale
short_description: Create professional UGC-style marketing videos in minutes without editing skills. Combine attention-grabbing hooks, text overlays, and call-to-action clips with background music to generate viral-ready content at scale. Perfect for marketers, content creators, and small businesses looking to produce consistent, high-quality video content.
author: vishnuhimself

sections.overview:
UGCVidGen is a Python script that automates the creation of user-generated content style videos by combining hook videos, text overlays, call-to-action clips, and background music. The tool reads hooks from a CSV file, randomly selects from your music library, and generates finished videos saved to a folder with automatic logging. It handles video resizing and cropping to standardize dimensions, tracks used hooks to prevent repetition, and supports customizable text size, color, and fonts. This skill solves the time-consuming video production bottleneck for marketers, small business owners, and content creators who need consistent, high-quality UGC-style content at scale without manual editing.
Generate multiple UGC-style marketing videos for product launches
Create consistent social media content with different hooks and CTAs
Produce viral-ready short-form videos for TikTok and Instagram Reels
Batch-create promotional videos with uniform branding and music
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/vishnuhimself/UGCVidGen`
sections.usage:
```
Create a 30-second UGC-style video for [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] industry. The video should include: 1) An attention-grabbing hook about [PRODUCT/SERVICE], 2) 3 key benefits with text overlays, 3) A call-to-action asking viewers to visit [WEBSITE] or use [PROMO_CODE], and 4) Background music that matches the brand's vibe. Make it look authentic and engaging, like content from a real customer.
```
